points.description: Final answer 28 is reached via a fully valid argument: identical dice give p1²=0.04 and p6²=0.01, so p1=0.2, p6=0.1; P(7)=2(p1p6+p2p5+p3p4)=2(0.02+p2p5+p3p4); with p2+p3+p4+p5=0.7, maximise p2p5+p3p4 (AM-GM gives ≤ (p2+p5)²/4+(p3+p4)²/4, maximised at 0.7²/4=0.1225 with the other pair 0, e.g. p2=p5=0.35), so p=0.285 and floor(100p)=28. Equivalent valid methods earn the mark. Any invalid step or wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: All-or-nothing, 1 mark: needs p1=0.2, p6=0.1, a valid maximisation giving p=0.285, and final answer 28. Any wrong step or wrong answer gets 0.
rubric.answer_key: p1=0.2, p6=0.1. P(7)=2(0.02+p2p5+p3p4). Remaining mass 0.7; max of p2p5+p3p4 is 0.7²/4=0.1225 (all mass on one pair, equal split). p=2(0.1425)=0.285. Answer: 28.
